name: Lingyang

tierList.prydwen: T3 Tower of Adversity, T4 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: 5-star Glacio Gauntlets Hypercarry with a unique airborne 'Striding Lion' Ultimate stance - flies, juggles non-elite enemies, and alternates Basic Attack/Resonance Skill to exploit his Diligent Practice passive. Deals the bulk of his damage in one long Ultimate-locked burst window; not quickswap-friendly.

skills.normalAttack: Majestic Fists Basic Attack (5 hits, replaced by Feral Roars after Furious Punches) / Feral Gyrate (2 hits) while airborne.
skills.resonanceSkill: Ancient Arts (base) / Furious Punches (after Basic 3/4/5 or Feral Roars, feeds Forte fast) / Mountain Roamer while airborne.
skills.forte: Unification of Spirits - at full Lion's Spirit, Heavy Attack: Glorious Plunge enters Striding Lion (airborne, enhanced kit) for up to 15s (10s with Ultimate active).
skills.liberation: Strive: Lion's Vigor - Glacio hit, grants Lion's Vigor (+50% Glacio DMG Bonus for 14s, slows Lion's Spirit consumption).
skills.intro: Lion Awakens - Glacio strike, fills much of his Forte gauge on its own.
skills.outro: Frosty Marks - AoE Glacio shockwave (587.94% ATK).

bestWeapons: Legend of Drunken Hero (79.5%, best gacha-free)
echoSet: Endless Resonance (100%, best - up to 30% ramping ATK%, but incompatible with quickswap)

teams.name: Best Team
teams.notes: Lynae has the strongest generalist buffs (pairs well with Mornye); Zhezhi provides strong off-field Coordinated Attack damage plus a 20% Glacio/25% Skill DMG Outro.

teams.name: F2P Team
teams.notes: Sanhua has a very fast rotation and 38% Basic ATK DMG Amplify Outro, free-to-play alternative when Zhezhi is unavailable/occupied.

rotation: Echo -> Intro -> Ultimate -> Heavy: Glorious Plunge (airborne) -> alternate Basic/Skill (Feral Gyrate P1, Mountain Roamer, P2, Mountain Roamer, P1, Mountain Roamer, P2, Mountain Roamer, P1) -> Stormy Kicks -> Mid-air Tail Strike -> Outro. Up to 9 independent attacks executable during his Ultimate window if uninterrupted.
communityNotes: Prydwen: unique flying playstyle unlike any other character, easy button-mashing burst combo, but falls slightly behind comparable DPS in raw damage and the airborne mechanics/odd boss hitboxes make him harder to learn than most, keeping his overall endgame usage low.
